naset_body_full.name: Corps Complet N'Aset OFM
naset_body_full.prompt: Tall elegant African Egyptian woman warrior priestess, 1.78m height, athletic sovereign silhouette, dark brown skin with warm golden undertones, almond-shaped eyes with Egyptian kohl, high cheekbones, regal posture. Wearing white ivory draped fabric with golden sacred collar (Usekh necklace), red Maasai Shuka drape, golden sacred jewelry with #C9963A gold color. Egyptian futuristic aesthetic. Standing neutral pose, T-pose preferred for rigging. Ultra detailed, realistic, 4K texture quality.
naset_body_full.negative_prompt: low quality, blurry, deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs, missing limbs, ugly face, cartoon, anime, western style

naset_head.name: Tête et Visage N'Aset
naset_head.prompt: African Egyptian woman face, perfect anatomy, dark brown skin #6B3D2E warm tone, SSS subsurface scattering, almond eyes with dark iris #1A0D00 and Egyptian black kohl liner, high cheekbones, straight nose with slightly wider base, full lips with deep bordeaux #7B2D2D color, long afro natural hair or straight Egyptian bob cut, deep black hair #0D0A08. Regal neutral expression, eyes slightly downcast sovereign gaze. Ultra realistic, 4K PBR textures, sculpt quality.
naset_head.negative_prompt: western features, european nose, light skin, cartoon, stylized, deformed ears, bad topology

naset_usekh_collar.prompt: Ancient Egyptian Usekh pectoral collar necklace, Maasai inspired colorful beads (red, orange, yellow, white, black), golden #C9963A sacred gold metal base, semicircular wide collar design, Egyptian hieroglyphic motifs, Ankh and Eye of Horus symbols, handcrafted artisan quality, multiple rows of beads, sacred jewelry for royalty and divine priestess.
